# TmuxQuest

> Learn tmux by playing - a free, desktop browser game that teaches real tmux through mission-based play on a faithful fake-tmux engine.

TmuxQuest teaches the actual tmux key bindings and workflows - panes, windows, sessions, copy-mode and the command prompt - through a short, chapter-based campaign of focused missions. It runs entirely client-side, needs no account or install, and is free. Desktop only (no mobile support).

## Links

- [Play TmuxQuest](https://tmuxquest.com/): the game itself
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/tmuxquest/tmuxquest): public source repository
